about: Work in progress. Popular Massive presets from PresetShare, each rendered from its own MIDI demo in Massive and, after conversion, in Vital. Same notes, same tempo, no normalization. MIDI cut at 30 s.

notes: mod osc filter-fm modulation not converted

feedback 0.42: level only (light feedback, no Vital saturation)
